nodes.name: Geofence Webhook
nodes.notes: iOS Shortcuts POSTs here when you arrive home. URL: {WEBHOOK_URL}/webhook/geofence-trigger

nodes.name: Manual Send Trigger
nodes.notes: Manual trigger via POST request or WhatsApp command. URL: {WEBHOOK_URL}/webhook/manual-send

nodes.name: Validate & Prepare
nodes.notes: Validates webhook secret, determines trigger type.

nodes.name: Wait 5 min (Sync Buffer)
nodes.notes: Gives Google Drive time to finish syncing photos from your phone before we query for undelivered media.

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  m.id AS media_id,
  m.original_filename,
  m.local_path,
  m.is_video,
  m.friends_identified,
  m.faces_recognized,
  m.session_id,
  s.session_name,
  array_length(m.friends_identified, 1) AS friend_count
FROM media_files m
LEFT JOIN hangout_sessions s ON m.session_id = s.id
WHERE m.status = 'processed'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM delivery_logs dl 
    WHERE dl.media_file_id = m.id 
    AND dl.status IN ('sent', 'delivered', 'read')
  )
ORDER BY m.taken_at ASC;

nodes.name: Load Undelivered Media
nodes.notes: Fetches all processed media that hasn't been successfully delivered yet. Uses NOT EXISTS for deduplication safety.

nodes.name: Has Recognized Friends?
nodes.notes: Filters out photos where no friends were recognized. Those go to a 'skipped' log.

nodes.name: Route: Group vs DM
nodes.notes: Core routing: 2+ friends → group, 1 friend → DM. Photos as documents, videos as media.

nodes.name: Prepare Contact Lookup
nodes.notes: Prepares contact lookup for DM recipients.

nodes.name: Is DM?
nodes.notes: Splits group messages (which already have JID) from DMs (which need DB lookup).

parameters.query:
SELECT whatsapp_jid, display_name, send_preference
FROM friends_contacts
WHERE subject_name = '{{ $json._friendToLookup || $json._routing.friendName }}'
  AND is_active = true
  AND consent_given = true
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Lookup Friend Contact
nodes.notes: Looks up WhatsApp JID from friends_contacts. Only sends to active friends who gave consent.

nodes.name: Build Send Payload
nodes.notes: Merges routing + contact into final Evolution API payload. Respects send_preference.

nodes.name: Rate Limit Delay
nodes.notes: Random delay between 3-8 seconds per message. Critical for avoiding WhatsApp bans.

nodes.name: Send via WhatsApp
nodes.notes: Sends media via Evolution API. Photos as 'document' (full quality), videos as 'video' (normal). Uses 'composing' presence for human-like behavior.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO delivery_logs (
  media_file_id,
  session_id,
  recipient_type,
  recipient_jid,
  recipient_name,
  sent_as,
  status,
  whatsapp_msg_id,
  sent_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.mediaId }}'::uuid,
  {{ $json.sessionId ? "'" + $json.sessionId + "'::uuid" : 'NULL' }},
  '{{ $json.recipientType }}',
  '{{ $json.recipientJid }}',
  '{{ $json.recipientName }}',
  '{{ $json.sendAs }}',
  'sent',
  '{{ $json.key?.id || $json.messageId || '' }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (media_file_id, recipient_jid) DO NOTHING;

nodes.name: Log Delivery
nodes.notes: Records successful delivery. ON CONFLICT prevents duplicate log entries.

parameters.query:
UPDATE media_files SET status = 'delivered', delivered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.mediaId }}'::uuid;

nodes.name: Build Summary
nodes.notes: Compiles delivery stats into a summary message.

nodes.name: Send Summary to Me
nodes.notes: Sends a WhatsApp message to yourself with the delivery summary.

parameters.query:
UPDATE media_files SET status = 'skipped', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.media_id }}'::uuid AND status = 'processed';

nodes.name: Mark Skipped (No Friends)
nodes.notes: Photos with no recognized friends are marked as 'skipped' so they're not reprocessed.
